title: Castle Crashers
desc: Castle Crashers is a beat'em all game for four players in multiplayer on Xbox 360. An arena mode allows human opponents to fight each other. Each character can unlock over 40 different weapons, adopt animal companions, go treasure hunting and spend their gold in a multitude of shops with various contents.

title: Sonic the Hedgehog 4: Episode I
desc: The sequel fans have waited 16 years for is finally here - Sonic the Hedgehog 4 Episode I! Featuring enhanced gameplay elements, including the classic Sonic Spin Dash, and the versatile Homing Attack, Sonic the Hedgehog 4 Episode I picks up right where Sonic and Knuckles™ left off. Dr. Eggman's back, and in an effort to finally rid himself of Sonic, he revisits – and improves – the very best of his creations. Get ready for the next chapter in an all new epic 2D saga built for old and new fans alike.
